purpose: Research operationalization of public case semantics pending recovery of authentic course definitions
time_units: stock trading-session index; all windows include only explicitly named offsets
source_scope: ACT-067B verified common indicators, full same-market listing-origin OHLCV through 2026-11-06; original three-layer 344 dates; frozen native same-input V4.0 replay; archived 342-date overlap tracked separately

key_k_proxy.expression: C>O and pct>=3.0 and V>=1.20*mean(V[D-5:D-1]) and C>W>Y
key_k_proxy.anchor_id: KEY_K@ISO_DATE; key-K anchor floor is anchor L

method_19.raw: BBI > W AND W > Y AND J <= 13
method_19.anchor_selection: Latest preceding RAW or Key-K; if both share a date, label BOTH. Once selected, that date is the anchor for that D. No candidate formed on D can be its own anchor.
method_19.peak_trough_rule: Find the highest H with earliest tie from anchor through D-1. Find the lowest L with earliest tie strictly after that peak through D. Pullback is real when the trough is below that peak and some post-peak close is below its prior close. Reject an observation if any post-anchor close through D is below the anchor floor.
method_19.volume_rule: V at trough divided by each of the five and ten completed sessions preceding the trough; both ratios <=0.85. Attack-peak denominator = V on price-peak session and ratio is reporting-only.
method_19.support: C/Y-1>=0, C/W-1>=-2.5%, abs(pct)<=3.5%; intraday line classification recorded separately, needle alternative remains UNKNOWN
method_19.output: FORMAL_B1_SHADOW TRUE requires ordered anchored pullback/shrink, support, anchor floor valid and RISK_CLEAR_SHADOW TRUE. Certified RISK_CLEAR and FORMAL_B1 are UNKNOWN where official risk missing unless computed prerequisites independently fail.
method_19.support_evidence: A raw W close-cross can satisfy the effective W tolerance only while close stays within -2.5% and Y is held; raw close-cross and effective support are distinct.

method_20.base_expression: D0-10..D0-1 contains preceding TRUE Formal_B1_Shadow, or a session S with L at a five-session low including S, J<=20, V<=0.85*its preceding MA5, C>=Y and C<=W; all conditions evaluated on S
method_20.oral_core_shadow: preceding base AND C>O, (C/O-1)*100>=3, (C-O)/(H-L)>=0.5, (C-L)/(H-L)>=0.7, V>=1.20*both preceding V and preceding MA5
method_20.user_f03: at least one J<13 within D-2..D; V>1.25*MA of D-4..D-1; pct>4; J<70; W>Y; no B1 prerequisite
method_20.later_retest: Per track, latest preceding D0 within 1..10 sessions; D low at least 1% below its close, V<=0.85*previous MA5, C>=Y, C>=W*(1-0.025), abs(pct)<=3.5, RISK_CLEAR_SHADOW=true. D0 and retest disjoint for the same anchor, exact authentic formal thresholds remain UNKNOWN.

method_25.damage: On first session of consecutive damage condition C<W and L<=Y. Freeze latest Key-K strictly before damage and last confirmed structural swing whose pivot center precedes D; if unavailable preserve UNKNOWN provenance.
method_25.swing_high: A pivot with H greater than all four H of two previous and two following sessions, available on second right-side session. When D opens a damage record, its as-of swing high and original anchor are immutable.
method_25.yellow_test: First distinct S within 1..12 sessions after D with L/Y-1 in [-2%,1%], C>=Y, pct>=-3.5, V<=0.85*previous MA5. Preserve close relation and intraday pierce/recover.
method_25.rebuild: First distinct C within 1..10 sessions after T with O<C; body>=3% of O; body/range>=0.5, close-location>=0.7; V>=1.2*both preceding MA5 and T volume; C>W and C>T high. C requires a complete earlier D, T and preserved Key-K history for structural shadow qualification.
method_25.history: Sequential immutable D records with root Key-K date, original floor and previous damage ID. T freezes damage-to-T low and close-break status against original floor. Later C keeps that historical breach even when a fresh close is above it. Pending chain expires if either window closes. A later distinct D may replace the pending chain, never the prior record.

drawdown.operation: 100*(frozen pre-D pivot high minus lowest L from D_DAMAGE through T_YELLOW_TEST inclusive)/pivot high

method_25.output: REBUILD_SHADOW requires D<T<C, original Key-K history preserved, RISK_CLEAR_SHADOW and C close >= original frozen root floor. Certified risk remains UNKNOWN when official historical flags are missing and no specific blocker supplies a negative result.
method_25.old_root_risk: OLD_ROOT_ANCHOR_STILL_INVALID: FALSE-clear if the current candidate close lies below the original immutable key-K low, TRUE-clear if at or above it, UNKNOWN if that floor is unavailable. At damaged/retest/confirm stages report each close relative to the old floor and retain all previous historical breaks independent of the current price. Price damage C<W and L<=Y is a research proxy.
method_25.onset_selection: Every distinct observed onset is appended with original root/confirmed swing and prior onset ID. An unexpired active chain retains D/T precedence; a concurrent distinct onset remains auditable as NOT_ACTIVATED_PENDING_CHAIN. On C or expiry append immutable terminal record and release active chain. A first onset on the same session as incumbent expiry logs the expiry before activating the fresh onset.

risk.risk_clear_shadow: FALSE if any last-five deep close versus Y, large bearish distribution (negative body >=5% of open and volume >=1.5*preceding MA5), or suspected ST proxy. ST proxy on ordinary 10% board after first five sessions: 5%-like one-word session or at least two last-20 5%-like close-at-extreme sessions including a current such cap. If no observed blocker but any required evidence unavailable, UNKNOWN; otherwise TRUE.
risk.risk_clear_certified: FALSE when a shadow blocker is observed; UNKNOWN otherwise because official historical ST/delisting coverage is unavailable.

shape_proxy.evidence: Deterministic D-only candle label, independent of all method decisions; no human visual endorsement.

charts.meaning: All left and right axes frozen by the normalized D-ending 35-session slice. D+1..D+15 may render off-scale markers; forward data never participates in geometry, signals or blind selection.
